what: Let a gym owner switch on auto-renew for the MettleUp plan (one approval with the payment company, then each month or year is taken by itself, with the same receipt)
why: Today every renewal is a fresh one-day pay link the owner must open and pay by hand; a busy owner who misses the 7, 3 and 1 day reminders drops to an unpaid gym
impact_why: Renewals are MettleUp's own income; a missed manual payment is lost money and a gym that may not come back
my_view: My view: worth it after the first 20 paying gyms, not before. Razorpay and Cashfree both sell UPI AutoPay and card mandates (as known by Jun 2026, not re-checked live). Keep the pay link as the fallback. This is the gym owner's MettleUp plan, not members' fees (that idea is already on the list).

what: In the 7-day plan-end reminder to a gym on monthly billing, add one line with the yearly price and what it saves, with a 'Pay for 12 months' button
why: The nightly job sends reminders that carry only the days left; the best moment to sell a year is when the owner is about to pay anyway
impact_why: Each switch to yearly is a year of money up front and one less renewal that can be missed
my_view: My view: do it; the yearly checkout already exists, this is only words and a button in a reminder that already goes out. Say the saving in rupees, not percent.

what: After a gym's paid MettleUp plan ends, send two win-back reminders (the day after and 7 days after) with the renew link, and list those gyms for HQ to call
why: The nightly job reminds only before the end (7, 3 and 1 days); once the day passes nothing more is sent, so a gym that simply forgot is never asked again
impact_why: Lapsed gyms are the cheapest paying gyms to win back; one call or message often settles it
my_view: My view: do it, but stop after the second reminder so it never feels like nagging. The HQ list matters more than the messages.

what: Let the gym's join-online link carry a member's Bring-a-friend code, so a friend who joins online is credited to that member without the desk doing anything; also ask an optional 'How did you hear about us' with 4 chips
why: An online join is saved with no source at all, and the join form takes no referrer, so a friend who joins online instead of walking in earns the member nothing and the owner never learns which channel works
impact_why: Online joining plus referral is the growth loop; without the link between them the reward stops working exactly where it should grow
my_view: My view: do it next to the Bring-a-friend work; reuse the existing friend code, never a new one. Keep the chips optional so the form stays short.

what: When a personal-training class is booked or cancelled, send the member a pop-up, and one more 2 hours before the class
why: A booking is saved for the trainer's week only; the member hears nothing unless the desk calls or messages by hand, and member pop-ups have no kind for training classes
impact_why: Missed PT classes cost the trainer an hour and the gym a paid session; a reminder is the usual fix
my_view: My view: do it; gym booking apps such as Mindbody and Glofox send booking reminders as standard (as known by Jun 2026, not re-checked live). Words only: day, time, trainer's first name; never a price.

what: Let the trainer or desk mark a personal-training class as Done or No-show, and show a month count per trainer (classes done, no-shows)
why: A booking can only be made or cancelled; nothing records whether it happened, so the owner cannot pay trainers per session, count a PT pack down, or see who keeps missing
impact_why: Indian gyms commonly pay trainers per PT session; today that count is kept on paper
my_view: My view: do it before any more PT features; every later idea (pack count, trainer pay, no-show follow-up) needs this one fact first.

what: When a visitor on the gym's web page chat says 'I want to join', answer with the gym's join-online link (and the free trial when it is on), not only a promise of a call back
why: The contact step only marks the enquiry 'wants join' and sets a follow-up for today; a ready-to-join visitor then waits for a call that may come hours later
impact_why: Visitors are warmest in the minute they ask; each hour of waiting loses some of them
my_view: My view: do it when both switches are on (web page chat and join online); keep the call-back option next to it for people who want to talk first.

what: Add 'Repeat every month' to a challenge, so next month's copy starts by itself on the 1st with the same goal and prize days
why: A challenge has fixed start and end days and no repeat; the owner must create the same check-in challenge again every month or it quietly stops
impact_why: Monthly challenges keep members coming; one that stops because nobody re-made it loses that habit
my_view: My view: do it; one new field and a nightly copy. Tell the owner on the bell when a new month's copy starts.

what: When the gym marks a member's message as done, ask the member one tap: 'Was this sorted? Yes / No', and show the owner the share of Yes this month
why: A message can be marked done by the gym alone; the owner never learns whether complaints were really fixed in the member's eyes
impact_why: Useful for owners who care about service; a No can reopen the thread before the member leaves
my_view: My view: later, after the bell work settles; a No should simply reopen the thread, nothing more.
